exceptions.rationale: Affected brace-expansion versions are reachable only through development-time lint and PWA build tools using repository-controlled glob patterns; BeerMe does not pass user input to Node glob expansion. Remove when those tools accept brace-expansion 5.0.8.
The advisory affects only React Router's unstable RSC APIs. BeerMe is a browser-only SPA with no RSC routes or server actions. Remove after a patched React Router release is available.
